text: After this you can choose suitable evidence for a configuration audit question.

An audit asks whether claims about a product are backed by evidence. A functional review compares expected behavior with suitable test results. A physical review examines whether the actual hardware and software correspond to the released description. These checks serve different purposes. Passing a test does not identify all parts. Matching the parts list does not prove performance. Findings stay visible until they receive a documented disposition.
